title: A Data-Driven Framework for Identifying and Prioritizing RPA Opportunities in Healthcare Processes
abstract: arXiv:2609.09137v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is widely used to reduce administrative burden in United States hospitals, yet an estimated 30-50% of RPA initiatives underperform because processes are selected informally, without a repeatable method to catalogue candidates, prioritize them, match each to an automation tier -- a Python bot, an open-source orchestrator such as n8n, or an enterprise platform such as UiPath -- and forecast financial return before committing resources. We propose a four-module, data-driven framework unifying these decisions: a Process Taxonomy of twenty recurring hospital processes across five value streams; a Prioritization module deriving an Automation Suitability Index from an Analytic Hierarchy Process matrix with an explicit consistency check; a Tool-Tier Selection module recommending the least-cost technology sufficient for a process complexity, integration, and compliance profile; and a Return-on-Investment module qu

translated_title: 一种用于识别和优先排序医疗流程中RPA机会的数据驱动框架
translated_abstract: 机器人流程自动化（RPA）被广泛用于减轻美国医院的管理负担，然而据估计30-50%的RPA项目表现不佳，原因在于流程选择是非正式的，缺乏可重复的方法来编目候选流程、确定优先级、将每个流程匹配到相应的自动化层级（Python机器人、n8n等开源编排器或UiPath等企业平台），并在投入资源前预测财务回报。我们提出了一个统一这些决策的四模块数据驱动框架：涵盖五个价值流的二十个常见医院流程的流程分类法；通过层次分析法矩阵并带有明确一致性检验推导出自动化适宜性指数的优先级排序模块；根据流程复杂性、集成和合规性概况推荐成本最低的足够技术的工具层级选择模块；以及投资回报模块。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个整合流程分类、优先级排序、工具层级选择和投资回报预测的四模块数据驱动框架，为医院系统化地识别和优先排序RPA自动化机会提供了可重复的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a four-module data-driven framework—encompassing process taxonomy, prioritization, tool-tier selection, and ROI forecasting—to provide a repeatable method for hospitals to systematically identify and prioritize RPA automation opportunities.
